tools.name: transfer_ticket_with_upgrade_fee
tools.description: Moves a ticket to a higher-priced seating section and charges the customer's saved card for the price difference.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")


@dataclass
class UpgradeResult:
    ticket_id: str
    new_section: str
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_ticket_with_upgrade_fee(ticket_id: str, new_section: str, customer_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> UpgradeResult:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"ticket_id": ticket_id, "upgrade_to": new_section},
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect("ticketing.db")
    with conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE tickets SET section = ?, seat = NULL WHERE id = ?", (new_section, ticket_id))
    conn.close()
    return UpgradeResult(ticket_id, new_section, intent.id, fee_cents)

tools.name: run_attendee_import_job
tools.description: Runs the attendee import script on a CSV file for the given event.

params.name: csv_path
params.description: Path to the attendee CSV file

tools.code:
import subprocess

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")


@mcp.tool()
def run_attendee_import_job(event_id: str, csv_path: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/import_attendees.py", "--event", event_id, "--file", csv_path],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    return result.stdout + result.stderr
